diagram_previews.alt: Circle omega with centre O and a blue circle Gamma through O meeting omega at A and B. The diameter CD of omega passes through O and through P, the second intersection with Gamma. Segments PA and PB are drawn; the red dashed line from P to O', the point of Gamma opposite O, bisects angle APB. Equal double arcs mark angle APC and angle BPD.
